result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: up to six months of reasonable transition assistance at Commerce One’s then-current rates, data delivery within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent written certification of deletion. It leaves the existing survival and support provisions intact and adds only the necessary transition obligations. Drafting is professional, although the data-delivery deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than directly from termination, and “thereafter” does not establish a specific deletion deadline.
